properties.name: Verification.method and .level carry no schema default, so a check recorded without them stores nothing for them; and SCHEDULED_FOR admits Verification and Decision, so a plan holds what an increment owes to check and to decide
properties.rationale: Both are the ROOT fixes their facts named, ruled on 2026-09-06 after a plain-English walkthrough. (1) fact:defect-a-verifications-level-and-method-can-be-set-only-at-birth-so-a-wrong-default-is-on-the-record-forever ranked three fixes; the symptom fix (a setter) shipped in v0.48.0; this is the cause fix — the schema stops declaring what the tool then asserted. DesignEpoch.status's `arrived` default is deliberately LEFT: its schema description argues it is a record not a choice, and Anthony did not rule on it. Existing stored Verifications keep whatever they carry; only new omissions store nothing. (2) fact:defect-a-planned-verification-cannot-be-scheduled-because-scheduled-for-does-not-enumerate-it: the alternative (a future-tense sibling of OCCURS_DURING) was weighed and buys nothing over the enumeration; SCHEDULED_FOR already carries dec:arrival-delta's commitment semantics, which fit a planned check. WHAT WAS NOT DONE: the Interface `medium` fallback still uses its schema default and still says so — a different field with its own argument, untouched; whether qs's 'partial verification status' needs MORE than this (a `partial` status, or per-clause findings) remains the open idea it was.
properties.subject: system
properties.summary: TWO SCHEMA RULINGS, Anthony 2026-09-06. (1) schema/verify.yaml: `default: test` removed from Verification.method and `default: unit` from Verification.level, each description saying why. The validator writes every declared default into the store, so an inspection recorded without a method READ `test` forever and no tool could correct it (Alex, v0.47.0; the injector class fixed for Artifact.granularity/volatility on 2026-08-12). Now absence means nobody said. No detector reads Verification.method or .level (every `level` reader is Component-side), so nothing else changes. One ingest test moved with it: an unknown method is still warned about and dropped, but NOTHING stands in for it — its assertion read Some("test") and now reads None; the ingest warning ('using the default') and the const's comment were made true. (2) schema/temporal.yaml: SCHEDULED_FOR.from = [Requirement, Capability, Question, Verification, Decision]. A planned check and a pending ruling can be placed in the increment that owes them; before, the only edge was past-tense OCCURS_DURING and dev_storyflow called using it 'a lie in the hint's own words'. Same class as adding Interface to VERIFIES.to on 2026-08-22. The extraction hint and the schedule_for tool description name the two new from-types. The list is still a list: an Artifact is refused, pinned. Stamp UNMOVED (29 node / 65 edge type names), so no upgrade doc. Pins in absence_means_nobody_said_and_a_plan_holds_a_check.rs, observed failing first (Some("test") stored; InvalidEdge Verification->DesignEpoch). validate_schema OK; core 1582/0; mcp 358/0; toolsnaps regenerated (1); fmt/clippy clean.
